Name: Vanilla Gear Crafting Extended
Author: PizzaTurtl
Description:
[b][color=#ffff00]This mod makes use of changes to content patching in Stardew Valley 1.6+. Ensure you're on the latest version before installing, backwards compatibility to 1.5 is not guaranteed![/color][/b]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[size=3]Stardew Valley 1.6+
SMAPI 4.0+
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=description]Content Patcher
[/url][/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24794]Craft Anything Framework[/url]
[/size]

[b][size=4]Installation Instructions:[/size]
[/b]1. Install Stardew Valley Modding API (SMAPI) Version 4.0.0 or higher
2. Install Content Patcher ([url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild/about-me?gameId=1303]Pathoschild[/url])
3. Install Craft Anything Framework ([url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MindMeltMax/about-me?gameId=1303]MindMeltMax[/url])
4. Download Vanilla Gear Crafting Extended (this mod) main file
5.1. Extract the .zip archive in your /Downloads/ folder to get all 3 individual modules and select which modules you would like to use by only copying those folders to your /Mods/ directory
OR
5.2. Extract the .zip archive directly into your /Mods/ directory and delete any modules you would not like to use


[size=4][b]Mod Details:[/b][/size]
This modular content pack adds balanced, lore-friendly crafting recipes for items in the base game normally obtainable from a sole source, thus providing an alternative means to acquire these items. Specifically, this mod aims to reduce reliance on RNG to obtain basic items such as early-game rings and weapons, and to provide alternative gameplay options to obtain certain tools without relying on shops as the only source.

[b][size=3]Modules:[/size]
Rings and Rods (optional):[/b] adds level-gated crafting recipes for Glow and Magnet Rings, Fiberglass Rod, and Iridium Rod.
[b]Weapons[b] (optional)[/b]:[/b] adds level-gated crafting recipes for many (but not all) base game standard weapons that normally only drop randomly from crates and enemies in the Mines. Late- and End-game weapons are not included and must still be obtained through their default methods.
[b]Tools (optional):[/b] adds level-gated crafting recipes for tool upgrades (copper through gold), providing an alternative means of acquiring upgraded tools outside of Clint's shop.

[b][size=3]Rationale for this Mod:[/size][/b]
[b][size=2]Rings and Rods, Weapons:[/size][/b]
Have you ever felt it odd that you can craft some pretty high-powered items (including rings), but don't have a crafting recipe for the basic Glow and Magnet rings? Have you ever been cursed with poor RNG and did not receive a Glow ring before reaching floor 30 of the Mines and had to stumble in the dark, or be forced to farm crates in earlier floors hoping to drop a ring? Likewise, have you found yourself braving the depths with an underpowered weapon due to poor luck and no weapon drops? 

These modules aims to add balanced recipes to provide the ability to acquire basic items to mitigate poor RNG and to provide alternative ways to acquire rings, fishing rods, and weapons besides random drops and/or being forced to purchase them with coins from shops. These modules also aim to support no-shop and related challenge runs, or to simply enable the player to be more self-sufficient.

[b]Tools:
[/b]Dislike Clint and loathe interacting with him or supporting his business? Trying to go for a no-shop challenge run, or simply hoping to feel more self-sufficient? Need to upgrade your watering can but you can't seem to get a rainy day for the life of you? This module aims to add balanced recipes to craft the basic tool upgrades (copper, iron, and gold) with the intention of providing more choice: save resources/coins by waiting for Clint to upgrade them for you, or spend more to upgrade yourself with no wait? The choice is yours. Tools crafted with this module are eligible for upgrade by Clint later, but can exist as duplicates in the player's inventory just as with multiplayer games with multiple instances of each tool.
[color=#ffff00][b]Note:[/b] Tool crafting is the least "Vanilla" of this content pack's modules, and as a byproduct of how Tools are coded in the game, these cannot be destroyed or removed by ordinary means. This module is OPTIONAL and not required to use the Rings/Rods or Weapons crafting modules.[/color]

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]Important Notes:[/size][/color]
[/b][b]Perfection: [/b]As far as I can tell, the Perfection tracker checks all known crafting recipes and determines whether each one has been crafted at least once. By adding additional crafting recipes, you will (as far as I know) be required to craft these items at least once to complete this aspect of Perfection. 

[b]Inventory:[/b] Due to how Tools are coded, it is not possible (at this time) to consume Tools for "upgrade" in the crafting recipe, nor is it possible to destroy existing tool instances. It is theoretically possible, albeit unlikely, to soft-lock your game by filling your inventory with un-droppable tools that would be impossible to remove if you don't have any chests or other item storage containers. Be intentional when crafting tools with this in mind!

[b]Removing Excess Tools/Weapons/Rings: [/b]The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3782]Ship Anything[/url] mod allows you to put items like tools, weapons, and rings into the shipping bin - use this mod if you'd like a way to offload tool variants or weapons/rings you don't need anymore!
[size=3]

[/size][b][size=4]Compatibility:
[/size][/b]This mod is natively compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115?tab=description]Better Crafting[/url] (crafting UI overhaul).


[b][size=4]About this Mod Family:[/size][/b]
This mod is part of the Vanilla Content Extended family of mods that aim to extend specific aspects of the vanilla game. These mods improve the vanilla gameplay experience by reducing reliance on RNG, expanding gameplay options to acquire non-rare items, and performing other minor changes that match the spirit of vanilla gameplay while reducing frustrating feature implementations. All mods in this mod family are extensively playtested for game balance to make them feel as if they were always part of the vanilla game, or as if they were part of a title update.

[size=3][b]Other mods in this mod family:[/b][/size]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25561]Vanilla Ores Extended[/url][/b] - adds low-yield nodes for vanilla ores in preceding zones to smooth resource collection as you descend the Mines
[b]Vanilla Shops Extended [/b]- selectively extend the inventories of vanilla shops to provide alternative ways to acquire previously-unpurchaseable common items, and some rare items locked behind RNG and/or grinding (coming soon)
